full_text:
ADDENDA (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 18 Statutes and Regulations to Expand Local Participation in Government Committees) <Presidential Decree No. 35940, December 23, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 11 Omitted.

Article 12 (Transitional measures concerning the amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education) The Environmental Education Committee constituted under Article 4(2) of the previous Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education as at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed constituted in conformity with the criteria in the amended second sentence of Article 4(2)2 of that Decree; provided, when members are commissioned after this Decree enters into force (excluding consecutive reappointments), members satisfying the criteria in the amended provisions shall be commissioned.

Article 13 Omitted.
